pages.text: A door opens for its owner, an admin, and anyone carrying a $(item)Garage Remote$() linked to it. From inside, anyone can open it: nobody's shut in.$(br2)Drive up to it and it $(l)opens by itself$(), then shuts behind you once you're through. $(k:key.reikocars.hitch) opens or closes it from the car, too.
Its owner's cars open it, whoever's driving.

$(l)Remotes:$() sneak-right-click your door with one to link it (up to 4 doors) and give it to whoever you want to let in. Right-click it, even driving, to open or close the nearest of its doors within 64 blocks. $(l)Reset remotes$() on the door's screen stops them all working.$(br2)A $(item)Garage Door Button$() on a wall works the nearest door within 16 blocks.

$(l)Safe inside:$() a car shut in a garage, behind a closed door and under a roof, can't be stolen, towed or impounded. Locked or not, only its owner and whoever has its key can get in it or tow it away.$(br2)It doesn't rust while it's in there, and no snow settles on it.
Shut, painted, windows along the top: whatever's inside is safe.
